parts.name: Area
parts.description: An area mark. It makes one filled `<path>` and one line per series. The points show only when they have the focus.

props.name: data
props.description: The rows of this mark. Without it, the mark uses the data of the root.

props.name: x
props.description: The x channel of this mark. It needs `data`. Without it, the mark uses the channel of the root.

props.name: y
props.description: The y channel of this mark. It needs `data`. Without it, the mark uses the channel of the root.

props.name: series
props.description: The series channel of this mark. It needs `data`. Without it, the mark uses the channel of the root.

props.name: key
props.description: The key channel of this mark. It needs `data`. Without it, the mark uses the channel of the root.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the series of this mark, when it has no series channel. The legend, the names of
the points and the data table show it. Give a name to each mark when two marks show two
fields, for example the revenue and the cost.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the group of the mark.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Puts the series one on the other. The default is `false`: each area starts at zero.

props.name: r
props.description: The radius of the point of each row, in pixels. The default is 0: the points are hidden.

props.name: focusRadius
props.description: The radius of the point that has the focus, in pixels. The default is 4.

dataAttributes.name: data-mark
dataAttributes.description: On the group of the mark. The value is `area`.

dataAttributes.name: data-stacked
dataAttributes.description: On the group of the mark, when `stacked` is `true`.

dataAttributes.name: data-series
dataAttributes.description: On the group of each series. The value is the name of the series.

dataAttributes.name: data-area
dataAttributes.description: On the filled path of each series.

dataAttributes.name: data-line
dataAttributes.description: On the top line of each series.

dataAttributes.name: data-point
dataAttributes.description: On each point: a circle, a rect for a bar, or a path for a dot or a slice.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: On the point that has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: On the focused point, when the focus came from the keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: On the selected point. The point also has `aria-current="true"`.
